_comment_AI_SERVICE_URL: Host-side address of ai-service. Docker publishes it as 8080:8000, so 8080 is correct
for anything running on the host (run-all.ps1, dotnet run). Compose overrides this with
This lives in appsettings.json, NOT only in appsettings.Development.json: a container does
not run in the Development environment, so a Development-only value would silently fall
through to a hardcoded default and fail as 'ai-service unreachable'.
